findings.title: Capacity reaches its limit
findings.claim: Hearing the reaching verb and the mature-strength noun together makes the grant of judgment and knowledge read as capacities that become available at a reached threshold, not as a detached gift after a merely biological milestone.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb marks arrival at an end point, the following noun specifies mature strength and sound judgment, and the Form IV giving then supplies what that readiness can bear. The three focus carriers explain one another as threshold, capacity, and reception.
findings.reader_payoff: Maturity becomes more than elapsed age: the sentence depicts a person arriving at a condition in which a responsible faculty can be received.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains Yusuf reaching maturity and receiving judgment and knowledge. This finding does not replace the developmental event with a generic theory of capacity.

epistemic.reason: The channel support is trusted and the focus carriers are supplied, but the two maturity-related lexicon records carry qualified identity status.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir yere, şeye veya son sınıra ulaşma; bağlama göre yaklaşma ya da olgunluğa erme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir zamanın, işin veya belirlenmiş ölçünün en son sınırına varmayı da kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: the verb of reaching the end point
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the following mature-strength noun and the ensuing act of bestowal
branch_activations.activation: The reaching verb is attached to a maturity object and immediately followed by the transfer of two faculties, so its limit becomes the point at which capacity is ready to receive.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The grant is read as the consequence of attained readiness rather than an unrelated addition after age.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains a threshold relation within the focus ayah; it does not claim that every use of the reaching verb means maturity.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: güç ve sağduyu bakımından olgunluğa erişme
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan bedensel güç, yetişkinlik, sağduyu ve deneyim bakımından olgunluk düzeyine erişir.
branch_activations.carrier: the noun naming Yusuf's completed strength and mature judgment
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the preceding verb of reaching a limit
branch_activations.activation: The mature-strength noun receives a concrete threshold from the reaching verb, turning adulthood into a state of gathered strength, experience, and soundness.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The maturity in the sentence is a usable readiness, not only a biological age marker.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains the supplied human maturity sense and does not assert a specific age.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: vermek; getirip sunmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
branch_activations.carrier: the divine act of giving judgment and knowledge to Yusuf
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the completed arrival at mature strength
branch_activations.activation: The giving verb meets the threshold-and-maturity sequence, so what is given is read as a fitting reception made possible by the preceding state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Bestowal depicts capacity meeting readiness: judgment and knowledge are received as what mature strength can responsibly bear.
branch_activations.boundary: The act remains a divine gift; readiness does not turn it into an earned possession.

findings.title: Judgment is granted within recompense
findings.claim: The pairing of judgment and knowledge with recompense and active good-doers frames the faculties as a morally situated return, binding capability to good action without reducing the gift to payment.
findings.mechanism: The two faculty objects are placed before the generalizing recompense clause, whose recipient class is named by an active participle for those who do good. Judgment supplies right discernment, knowledge supplies grasp of truth, recompense supplies return, and good-doing supplies the condition of the stated economy.
findings.reader_payoff: The final clause reaches backward: the gifts are not only what Yusuf receives, but an example of how the ayah understands good action and its fitting return.
findings.containment: The plain text still says that Yusuf is given judgment and knowledge and that good-doers are recompensed. This finding does not claim that the faculties are a wage or that divine giving is mechanically earned.

epistemic.reason: All four focus branches have accepted lexicon identity status and are supported by trusted channel evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgi ve usla doğruyu bulma yetkinliği
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bilgi ve us, kişinin doğruyu yanlıştan ayırıp doğru olana ulaşmasını sağlar.
branch_activations.carrier: the granted faculty of judgment
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the paired knowledge object and the recompense clause
branch_activations.activation: Judgment is placed beside knowledge and before the recompense statement, so its discernment becomes part of the fitting return rather than a bare office of authority.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The gift includes the capacity to distinguish rightly within the moral economy named at the end.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the supplied wisdom-and-discernment facet, not a claim that every legal or political sense of judgment is active.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilme ve gerçeğini kavrama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: the granted faculty of knowing and grasping truth
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the neighboring judgment object and the recompense-for-good tail
branch_activations.activation: Knowledge is coordinated with judgment rather than listed alone, and the following return clause makes the pair answerable to the ayah's good-doing frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Knowing is presented as an active moral capacity joined to right discernment.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding keeps knowledge as a granted faculty and does not add a separate teaching scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe denk karşılık verme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapılan eylem, niteliğine uygun ve onu karşılayacak bir iyilik ya da kötülükle yanıtlanır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The gifts can be heard as a fitting return within an active moral exchange, not as an isolated favor.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the positive direction selected by the focus object class is asserted here; the negative polarity is handled separately.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyi güzelleştirme, işi iyi yapma veya başkasına iyilik etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kötü davranmanın karşısında yer alan iyi ve güzel eylem, dalın ortak eylemsel çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: the active participle naming those who perform good action
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the recompense verb immediately governing that class
branch_activations.activation: The named recipients are not merely people possessing a good quality; their active good-doing is the class to which the recompense clause is attached.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The faculty-gift and the final assurance are joined by action, so capability is placed inside a process of doing good.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch concerns good action and its agent, not a claim that the people are intrinsically beautiful.

findings.title: From handled object to interpreting agent
findings.claim: The preceding handling and undervaluation of Joseph as an object are reversed when the grant makes him an established person with governing and interpretive agency.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace moves from bucket-mediated extraction, concealment as merchandise, and a reduced price through establishment and teaching to the focus transfer. Those contextual operations return to the focus giving as a restoration of subjecthood as well as capacity.
findings.reader_payoff: The gift is newly perceptible as a reversal in status: what was reached, hidden, and priced can now receive and use faculties that interpret what events become.
findings.containment: This is an attributed pericope-level reversal, not a claim that the ayah denies the ordinary maturation account or that every sale scene is a compensation narrative.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record has exact Arabic anchor texts and coordinates, but its target morphology and contextual branch lexicon are not independently supplied; the subjecthood reversal remains qualified inference.

findings.title: Judgment becomes restraint under pressure
findings.claim: The focus judgment is made newly visible as power to stop, redirect, and remain faithful when a closed setting presses toward misuse.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace places a bridle-like checking action at the focus beside closed doors, refuge, remembered benefaction, diversion, and separation from compromise. These contextual operations return to judgment as enacted restraint rather than authority alone.
findings.reader_payoff: Judgment gains a bodily and ethical shape: it is something that checks force and creates a boundary while pressure is still active.
findings.containment: The ordinary focus still names a granted faculty of judgment. The contextual reading does not claim that the ayah itself narrates the later scene or that all protection comes from Joseph alone.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact within the pericope, but target morphology and five contextual branch records are unavailable; the restraint synthesis is retained as attributed evidence.

findings.title: Recompense has a dangerous polarity
findings.claim: The focus recompense of good is placed beside a proposed recompense for alleged evil, so return becomes morally dependent on identifying the act and actor truthfully.
findings.mechanism: The same recompense branch occurs in the focus and in the sanction question at 12:25, where harm is alleged and imprisonment or pain is proposed. The repeated relation exposes both positive and punitive directions without deciding the accusation in the focus's favor.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing assurance is no longer a self-contained promise of benevolence; the reader can see why a return that fits an act also requires truthful adjudication.
findings.containment: The focus still states positive recompense for good-doers. This finding adds the later punitive mirror and does not declare Joseph's guilt or innocence through the mirror alone.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates and repeated branch are exact, but the target morphology and unresolved sanction branches are not independently supplied.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe denk karşılık verme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapılan eylem, niteliğine uygun ve onu karşılayacak bir iyilik ya da kötülükle yanıtlanır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Recompense is structurally bipolar, and its justice depends on a sound account of what happened.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied repeated-recompense relation is claimed; the later accusation is not accepted as fact.

branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied, and no punitive outcome is endorsed.

findings.title: A material sign constrains judgment
findings.claim: The granted knowledge can be read as the ability to read a relational material trace, while judgment tests rival claims before assigning truth or guilt.
findings.mechanism: The focus judgment and knowledge meet a witness, a longitudinal tear, opposed front and back orientations, paired conditionals, and later sight. The tear does not decide alone; its orientation becomes evidence that returns to the focus pair.
findings.reader_payoff: Knowledge becomes something the reader can see operating: a sign is read through its relation and used to constrain a decision.
findings.containment: The focus still grants judgment and knowledge. The garment scene supplies an attributed local proof procedure, not a claim that the focus words literally mean a garment or that every decision is reducible to physical evidence.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is strongly structured and coordinate-complete, but the target context morphology and five context branches remain unresolved.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Judgment is newly legible as assigning truth through a trace rather than deciding without a test.
branch_activations.boundary: The context procedure is attributed and local; no complete legal method is claimed.

findings.title: The form of a gift exposes its receiver
findings.claim: The repeated giving carrier changes its effect when what is given is an instrument before overwhelming perception: the focus gift can be read as a governed capacity, unlike a gift that exposes an ungoverned response.
findings.mechanism: The focus giving is paired with a later giving of knives, followed by direct sight, magnification, and self-cutting. The same transfer operation therefore meets two different kinds of recipient and reveals why the focus faculties matter.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish receiving a capacity for judgment and knowledge from receiving an instrument that magnifies impulse into bodily consequence.
findings.containment: The focus remains a divine bestowal of judgment and knowledge. The knife scene is an exploratory contextual contrast, not a claim that the two gifts are identical or that the repeated verb alone proves the relation.

epistemic.reason: The HFT source is legacy-unbound and the payload marks the relation exploratory; its coordinates are exact but contextual branch records lack independent lexicon detail.

findings.title: Precommitment and failed uptake
findings.claim: Judgment can secure a boundary because it recognizes vulnerability, while visible signs can be possessed without the ethical uptake that turns knowledge into just action.

The contrast separates preparation for weakness from mere access to evidence.

findings.containment: The focus remains a granted judgment-and-knowledge pair. The later failure is a qualified HFT inference, not a claim that every confinement decision or every sign is unjust.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates are complete and the structural contrast is clear, but the record is legacy-unbound, medium-confidence, and context branch records are unresolved.
